app.application.intro: Manage applications and their main and attached pages. Published pages can be registered as resources and opened.
app.application.name: Application name
app.designer.addHint: Drag into the canvas, or click to add to the selected layout.
app.designer.conflict: Another editor updated the server draft. Your changes are retained; review them before reloading.
app.designer.contextHint: Right-click a control or open its menu to copy, paste, move or remove it. Shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+C, V, Z and Delete.
app.designer.contractFailed: Unable to load design permissions and components
app.designer.cycle: Layouts and scene navigation cannot contain cycles.
app.designer.dataChoicesError: Choices must match the type and storage constraints and must not contain semantically duplicate values.
app.designer.dataConflict: This definition has changed. Close this dialog and edit it again.
app.designer.dataConstraints: Check the field name, length, precision and write policy.
app.designer.dataDefaultError: The default must match the type, length, precision and choices. Storage not null requires a non-null default.
app.designer.dataFieldType: This type is incompatible with existing controls or rules.
app.designer.dataIndexError: Select 1 to 8 distinct persistent fields. Their order determines the index order.
app.designer.dataLimit: The field, choice or index limit has been reached.
app.designer.dataMigrationHint: Changes are saved as a draft and take effect after publication. DNA evaluates schema changes; changes affecting existing data require migration review.
app.designer.defaultHint: Use the field type: true/false, YYYY-MM-DD, HH:mm:ss, or an ISO datetime with a timezone. Numbers retain precision and JSON retains its original text.
app.designer.emptyCanvas: Drag components here to start designing
app.designer.fieldAccessHint: Hidden applies to create or edit and prevents writes in that operation. Read-only and lifecycle rules intersect; platform field permissions still control data visibility.
app.designer.invalid: Unable to apply this change. Check the form configuration.
app.designer.invalidField: The field type is incompatible or the field is already used in this scene.
app.designer.invalidParent: Select a layout that accepts this component.
app.designer.label: Title
app.designer.limit: The form exceeds its field, component, or nesting limits.
app.designer.listOrderHint: Drag handles to set default business list columns, or use Space and arrow keys. Canvas layout and saved personal column preferences remain independent.
app.designer.matrixOccupied: Move components out of cells being removed and unlink their rules before shrinking the grid.
app.designer.patternHint: Use RE2 syntax; add ^ and $ for a full match. Backreferences and lookaround are not supported.
app.designer.previewHint: Try the form and its dialogs and drawers. Preview does not save business records.
app.designer.previewValid: Preview validation passed. No business records were saved.
app.designer.referenced: Check scene-opening actions. Remove references before deleting a scene.
app.designer.removeHint: Removing a control keeps its data field. Add it again from Data design.
app.designer.removeIndexHint: Remove this index from the draft? Database changes will be evaluated during publication.
app.designer.saveFailed: Unable to save the draft. Your changes are retained.
app.designer.storageRequiredHint: Draft records must satisfy this constraint too. A non-null default is required.
app.designer.typeHint: Available types must match every bound control. Update existing rule references before changing the type.
app.designer.unsupported: This component version is not supported. Update the designer before editing.
app.designer.writePolicyHint: Publishing applies write restrictions to older pages too; their existing stricter rules remain. Required create-only fields must be filled before the first save.
app.form.name: Form name
app.page.draftHint: Published pages become application entries. Use Design forms to manage this application’s forms.
app.page.name: Page name
app.publication.blocked: Existing data does not meet publication requirements. The page has not been switched.
app.publication.cancelled: This publication was cancelled. Existing pages are unchanged.
app.publication.dataUnavailable: Data is unavailable. Make sure you have data access to this page.
app.publication.failed: Publication is incomplete. Retry this publication.
app.publication.hint: Select a page in this application. After publication, users can enter and view data according to their page permissions.
app.publication.inspectionClear: There are no outstanding inspection results for this publication.
app.publication.inspectionFailed: Publication checks could not be loaded.
app.publication.repairHint: Correct data on a published page and retry, or cancel this publication and revise the design. Check counts may overlap; do not add them together.
app.publication.replaceHint: This page is bound to another form. Publication will switch it to this form and preserve the previous form data.
app.publication.requiredInput: Required fields need an editable input or a default. Check fields and scenes before publishing again.
app.publication.reviewRequired: These field changes require a data migration review. Adjust the design or contact an administrator.
app.publication.snapshot: This publication uses draft revision {revision}. Retries retain this snapshot.
app.publication.success: The form is published and ready to use.
app.publication.title: Publish form
app.publication.wait: Preparing the form and data. You can close this dialog and check again later.
app.release.cancelling: Confirming cancellation. Closing this window will not undo the request.
app.release.recovering: Resuming the original publication. History updates when it finishes; closing this window keeps the saved publication.
app.release.title: Publication history
app.resource.blocked: {count} submissions or workflows are unfinished. Resolve them before taking this resource offline.
app.resource.offlineEffect: Taking this resource offline closes its entry and revokes grants. Data and history are retained. New grants are required after bringing it online again.
app.resource.offlineFailed: Offline result is unconfirmed. Refresh or retry the same operation.
app.resource.progress: {done}/{total} required steps completed. Processing resumes when services recover.
app.resource.recoveryFailed: Could not continue the offline operation. Try again later.
app.resource.reonlineHint: Publish the form to this page again to bring it online.
app.rules.conflict: This rule has changed. Close the dialog and edit it again.
app.rules.invalidCondition: Choose valid fields and operators. Condition groups cannot be empty.
app.rules.invalidLiteral: Values must match the field type. Numbers retain precision; datetimes require a timezone.
app.rules.invalidTarget: Select a target compatible with this effect. Required rules apply only to persistent fields.
app.rules.limit: Each rule supports up to 32 nodes, 4 levels and 100 set values. A form supports up to 500 rules.
app.rules.orderHint: Rules run in list order. Later rules override earlier effects of the same kind.
app.rules.removeHint: Remove this rule from the draft? It takes effect after publication.
app.rules.scopeHint: Visibility and enablement affect the interface. The server validates required fields on submission. Enabling cannot override permissions or write policies. JSON compares content; empty objects, arrays and blank strings are empty.
app.rules.title: Interaction rules
app.runtime.discardForReload: Loading the new version discards unsaved changes. Continue?
app.runtime.invalidRoute: The application page address is invalid
app.runtime.retryHint: The last save result is uncertain. Retry before continuing to edit.
app.runtime.savedLaterVersion: The operation completed. The latest record version has been loaded.
app.runtime.savedUnavailable: The operation completed. The record is no longer available to view; refresh the data list.
app.runtime.unsupported: This form contains an unsupported component version. Contact its designer.
app.runtime.versionChanged: The form has changed. Load the new version to continue.
app.submission.accepted: Submission accepted. Check submission history for progress.
app.submission.title: Title
app.submission.uncertain: Confirming the submission result. Retry the original request.
app.workflow.metadataFailed: Could not load form metadata. Select the form again.
